decisions.reason: As a stand-alone system product that remained visible beyond launch, it likely showed enough market acceptance and strategic fit to justify keeping the option open.

Although only mentioned rather than prominently featured, it appears to be a low-cost complementary item, so a medium-sized German machinery firm would usually keep it unless demand had clearly disappointed.
Its dedicated product page and survival past the first review period suggest it is one of the stronger new options and worth retaining.

This looks like a more marginal component offer, but because it is related to the firm's core formwork and magnet portfolio and likely inexpensive to maintain, management would still be inclined to keep it for now.
